title: fix: add coerceToSafeValue to cell renderers at source, use getCellRenderer in HeaderHighlight
body:
Cell renderers (NumberCellRenderer, CurrencyCellRenderer, etc.) crashed with React error #310 when receiving non-primitive values from the API — MongoDB wrapper types (`{$numberDecimal}`), expanded reference objects, arrays of objects. The original issue also requested type-aware formatting in highlight fields, responsive column capping, performance optimizations, and metadata-driven configuration. ### Cell renderer safety (`@object-ui/fields`) - Added `coerceToSafeValue()` — coerces MongoDB types (`$numberDecimal`→Number, `$oid`→String, `$date`→String), expanded references (extract `name`/`label`/`_id`), arrays→comma-joined strings, Date→ISO string - Applied in all renderers: Number, Currency, Text, Percent, Date, Lookup, Email, Phone, URL, Formula - All consumers (tables, highlights, forms) benefit — fix is at the renderer level, not a consumer workaround ```ts // Before: raw object passed as React child → error #310 const formatted = typeof value === 'number' ? ... : value; // After: safe coercion at renderer entry const safe = coerceToSafeValue(value); // { $numberDecimal: "250000" } → 250000 // { _id: "x", name: "Acme" } → "Acme" // [{ name: "Alice" }, { name: "Bob" }] → "Alice, Bob" ``` ### HeaderHighlight type-aware rendering - Uses `getCellRenderer` with `objectSchema` enrichment (type, options, currency, precision, format) - Removed previous direct-formatting workaround — renderers are now safe at source ### autoLayout responsive column capping - `inferDetailColumns(fieldCount, containerWidth?)` — `<640px→1col`, `<900px→max 2col`; backward-compatible when omitted ### Activity panel collapse-when-empty - `RecordChatterPanel` gains `collapseWhenEmpty` prop, passed through to `RecordActivityTimeline` ### DetailSection progressive batch rendering - `VirtualScrollOptions` interface (`enabled`, `batchSize`, `itemHeight`) with `VS_REVEAL_DELAY`-based deferred reveal ### RecordDetailView optimizations - `detailSchema` wrapped in `useMemo` with granular deps - Hardcoded `HIGHLIGHT_FIELD_NAMES` removed — reads exclusively from `objectDef.views.detail.highlightFields` **Tests:** 134 targeted tests passing (16 `coerceToSafeValue` + 14 HeaderHighlight + cell renderer suites); 599 total across all related packages.
Original prompt > > ---- > > *This section details on the original issue you should resolve* > > 合并 SDUI 元数��平台 DetailView/RecordDetailView 重大优化（类型渲染/性能/响应式/虚拟化/元数据化） > ## 合并优化 Issue：DetailView/RecordDetailView 代码架构与体验提升 > > ### 1. HeaderHighlight 高亮区类型感知展示 > - **问题**：高亮栏金额等字段未格式化，直接 `String(value)` 渲染，丢失货币、枚举等类型语义。 > - **建议**：使用 getCellRenderer 进行类型感知展示。例如金额要格式化为 `$250,000.00`；stage 等枚举字段可用 Badge。已传递 type 信息，只需在 HeaderHighlight.tsx 内处理。 > > ### 3. RecordDetailView 生成 detailSchema 需 useMemo 优化 > - **问题**：每次渲染都重新组装 detailSchema 对象，导致无谓 re-render，影响性能。 > - **建议**：用 useMemo 包裹 detailSchema，依赖 objectDef、pureRecordId、related、childRelatedData、actionRefreshKey。 > > ### 4. autoLayout 列数推断需考虑容器宽度（响应式优化） > - **问题**：autoLayout 目前只按字段数量推断列数，iPad/手机等窄屏下易出现 3 列紧密排布，影响可读性。 > - **建议**：在 inferDetailColumns 增加对容器宽度的感知，或采用 CSS Container Query/useMediaQuery。宽度 <640px 强制1列，<900px 最多2列，其余按原逻辑。 > > ### 6. Activity/Chatter 面板空状态折叠 > - **问题**：底部无评论时 Activity 面板依然常显，占用大量页面空间。 > - **建议**：为 RecordChatterPanel/RecordActivityTimeline 传入 collapseWhenEmpty/defaultCollapsed 实现空状态自动收起。 > > ### 7. DetailSection 虚拟化渲染 > - **问题**：单一 section 字段多时全量挂载影响渲染性能。 > - **建议**：引入虚拟滚动配置（virtualScroll），在大字段数量时分批渲染/回收 DOM，提高性能。可用 @object-ui/react/usePerformance 已支持该配置。 > > ### 8. HIGHLIGHT_FIELD_NAMES 元数据化 > - **问题**：高亮字段名硬编码于代码中，不同业务��象场景下不适用。 > - **建议**：完全取自 objectDef.views.detail.highlightFields 配置，没有 fallback。 > > --- > > 本 issue 汇总上述 6 项平台级 SDUI 代码优化，兼顾类型安全、性能、移动端体验、真实元数据驱动等维度。 > > 相关组件涉及： > - `@object-ui/plugin-detail`（HeaderHighlight, DetailView, autoLayout, DetailSection, RecordChatterPanel, RecordActivityTimeline） > - `apps/console`（RecordDetailView 构建层） > > > > > > ## Comments on the Issue (you are @copilot in this section) > > > >
